mapper.select: /* LeavePolicyMapper.selectActivePolicy */ SELECT P.POLICY_SEQ AS policySeq , P.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , P.POLICY_PRESET AS policyPreset , P.AXIS1_GRANT_BASE AS axis1GrantBase , P.AXIS2_FISCAL_START_MM AS axis2FiscalStartMm , P.AXIS2_FISCAL_START_DD AS axis2FiscalStartDd , P.AXIS3_FIRST_YEAR_METHOD AS axis3FirstYearMethod , P.AXIS3_PREGRANT_YN AS axis3PregrantYn , P.AXIS4_PRORATE_ROUNDING AS axis4ProrateRounding , P.AXIS5_TENURE_MODE AS axis5TenureMode , P.AXIS5_START_YEAR AS axis5StartYear , P.AXIS5_INTERVAL AS axis5Interval , P.AXIS5_MAX_DAYS AS axis5MaxDays , P.AXIS6_VALIDITY_MONTHS AS axis6ValidityMonths , P.AXIS7_USE_PROMOTION AS axis7UsePromotion /* 소정-05: 법정 연차 자동 부여 토글(5인 미만 대응). 기본 'Y' — 기존 회사 동작 불변 */ , P.STATUTORY_AUTO_GRANT_YN AS statutoryAutoGrantYn , P.APRV_USE_YN AS aprvUseYn , P.USE_YN AS useYn , P.APPLY_FROM_DATE AS applyFromDate , P.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , DATE_FORMAT(P.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS insertDate , P.UPDATE_NO AS updateNo , DATE_FORMAT(P.UPDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS updateDate , U.USAGE_UNIT AS usageUnit , U.ALLOW_QUARTER AS allowQuarter , U.ALLOW_REMNANT_ROUND_UP AS allowRemnantRoundUp FROM TB_LEAVE_POLICY P LEFT JOIN TB_LEAVE_USAGE_POLICY U ON U.POLICY_SEQ = P.POLICY_SEQ WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.POLICY_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1

/* LeavePolicyMapper.selectActivePolicyForUpdate */ SELECT P.POLICY_SEQ AS policySeq , P.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , P.POLICY_PRESET AS policyPreset , P.AXIS1_GRANT_BASE AS axis1GrantBase , P.AXIS2_FISCAL_START_MM AS axis2FiscalStartMm , P.AXIS2_FISCAL_START_DD AS axis2FiscalStartDd , P.AXIS3_FIRST_YEAR_METHOD AS axis3FirstYearMethod , P.AXIS3_PREGRANT_YN AS axis3PregrantYn , P.AXIS4_PRORATE_ROUNDING AS axis4ProrateRounding , P.AXIS5_TENURE_MODE AS axis5TenureMode , P.AXIS5_START_YEAR AS axis5StartYear , P.AXIS5_INTERVAL AS axis5Interval , P.AXIS5_MAX_DAYS AS axis5MaxDays , P.AXIS6_VALIDITY_MONTHS AS axis6ValidityMonths , P.AXIS7_USE_PROMOTION AS axis7UsePromotion /* 소정-05: 법정 연차 자동 부여 토글. 변경 트랜잭션(FOR UPDATE)에서도 PREV 스냅샷 비교에 필요 */ , P.STATUTORY_AUTO_GRANT_YN AS statutoryAutoGrantYn , P.APRV_USE_YN AS aprvUseYn , P.USE_YN AS useYn , P.APPLY_FROM_DATE AS applyFromDate , P.INSERT_NO AS insertNo , DATE_FORMAT(P.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS insertDate , P.UPDATE_NO AS updateNo , DATE_FORMAT(P.UPDATE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS updateDate FROM TB_LEAVE_POLICY P WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY P.POLICY_SEQ DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

/* LeavePolicyMapper.selectPolicyHistory */ SELECT H.HIST_ID AS histId , H.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , H.POLICY_SEQ AS policySeq , H.CHANGE_TYPE AS changeType , CAST(H.PREV_SNAPSHOT AS CHAR) AS prevSnapshot , CAST(H.NEW_SNAPSHOT AS CHAR) AS newSnapshot , H.CHANGE_REASON AS changeReason , CAST(H.IMPACT_SUMMARY AS CHAR) AS impactSummary , H.INSERT_NO AS insertNo /* 변경자 표기용: INSERT_NO(USER_CD)로 TB_USER 조인. 'SYSTEM' 등 사용자코드가 아니면 NULL → FE는 insertNo 원문 폴백 */ , U.USER_ID AS insertUserId , U.USER_NM AS insertUserNm , DATE_FORMAT(H.INSERT_DATE, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS insertDate FROM TB_LEAVE_POLICY_HISTORY H LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.CMPNY_CD = H.CMPNY_CD AND U.USER_CD = H.INSERT_NO WHERE H.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} ORDER BY H.INSERT_DATE DESC, H.HIST_ID DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
/* LeavePolicyMapper.countActiveUsers */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_USER WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND WITHDRAWAL_DATE IS NULL AND ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01'

/* LeavePolicyMapper.selectActiveUsersForImpact */ SELECT U.USER_CD AS userCd , U.USER_NM AS userNm , N.NODE_NM AS deptNm , U.HIRE_DATE AS hireDate , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(G.GRANT_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ), 0) AS currentGrant , IFNULL(( SELECT SUM(G.USED_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.USER_CD = U.USER_CD AND G.DEL_YN = 'N' AND G.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ), 0) AS currentUsed FROM TB_USER U LEFT JOIN TB_SITE_NODE N ON N.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND N.SITE_CD = U.SITE_CD AND N.NODE_CD = U.NODE_CD WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.WITHDRAWAL_DATE IS NULL AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS = '01' /* 입사일이 입력된 직원만 영향 분석 대상에 포함 (입사일 미입력자는 부여 기준 산정 불가) */ AND U.HIRE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(U.HIRE_DATE) <> '' ORDER BY U.HIRE_DATE ASC, U.USER_CD ASC LIMIT #{limit}
